summary: Validated three newly-added frontend features (WhatsApp deep-link, Call deep-link, DnD queue reorder, Admin suspend/approve controls) plus a light customer regression against the deployed backend at pro-booking-21.emergent.host. All primary flows PASS. Only design/nit findings — no functional blockers.

issues: Uses the browser-native <input type="date"> picker for From/To (data-testid history-start-date / history-end-date) instead of the shadcn Calendar component used elsewhere in the app — inconsistent UX.

Suspend button reuses PUT /admin/providers/{id}/reject (see AdminDashboard.jsx line 81 comment); the pill label reads 'suspended' but underlying status returned from backend is 'rejected'. Works today because AdminDashboard.jsx treats both 'rejected' and 'suspended' as isRejected, but is semantically fragile — recommend a dedicated /suspend endpoint or an explicit action=suspend|reject flag.
Rows on the provider live queue correctly show NO drag handle (queue-drag-* count = 0) — behaviour is as-designed but there is no visual hint that reorder is receptionist-only.

action_items: (Nit) Consider replacing the native date input on HistoryPage with the shadcn Calendar/DateRangePicker for consistency.
(Nit) Consider adding a dedicated /admin/providers/{id}/suspend endpoint so Suspend and Reject aren't overloaded onto the same route.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.jsx suspend() uses PUT /admin/providers/{id}/reject with a 'Suspended' toast — misleading if a future backend distinguishes reject vs suspend states.

WhatsAppModal buildTemplates() hard-codes a preview URL in the 'invite' template (https://slotnow-web.preview.emergentagent.com/login). Should read from process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL / a configurable share link so it doesn't leak the preview host into production.

ReceptionistDashboard sends `date: new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)` (UTC-based) for /queue/reorder — will be off-by-one in IST after 5:30am UTC/11:00pm IST rollover. Prefer server-local or explicit IST formatting.

QueueRow.jsx only renders Call & WhatsApp when `phone` is truthy — good — but rows with null phone silently disappear. Consider a disabled hint ('no phone on file') so receptionist knows why the row can't be contacted.
seed_data_creation: None new — the receptionist queue already had 6 pre-existing walk-ins from previous iterations; those were used for the drag-and-drop test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend host = https://slotnow-web.preview.emergentagent.com. Backend = https://pro-booking-21.emergent.host (external, do NOT modify). Login flow: choose role → phone → OTP=123456 → verify. IMPORTANT: after first-time OTP login the app shows a 'Set a PIN for quick login' interstitial; click the 'Skip' text button before doing any further UI action (there is no data-testid on Skip — flagging this for the main agent). Data-testids of interest: wa-modal, wa-option-<k>, wa-manual-input, wa-preview, wa-send-btn, wa-close-btn, queue-item-<id>, queue-drag-<id>, queue-call-<id>, queue-wa-<id>, history-item-<id>, history-whatsapp-<id>, history-call-<id>, admin-suspend-<id>, admin-unsuspend-<id>, admin-approve-<id>, admin-reject-<id>, admin-bulk-approve-btn. Verified findings: DnD triggers POST /api/queue/reorder with { date, ordered_ids } and the new order persists across a hard reload. window.open URL is https://wa.me/91<phone>?text=<encoded> and contains customer name, provider, service, date, time, token. Provider queue correctly does NOT render drag handles (drag_handles=0 for provider) so reorder is receptionist-only.
rca of the issue: No functional issues found in this iteration — all three feature sets (WhatsApp deep-link + templates, tel: deep-link, DnD reorder with persistence, admin suspend/unsuspend/approve/reject/bulk) behave as specified. Two design nits (native date picker on history; suspend reuses reject endpoint) were captured as non-blocking follow-ups.

receptionist_wa_call.manual_mode: textarea present, send disabled when empty (true) and enabled after typing (false)
